note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission complètes : le diplôme néerlandais havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4 est mentionné ; des exigences supplémentaires s'appliquent pour certains profils. Contactez l'école pour un diplôme marocain.
note.en: Check full admission requirements: Dutch havo, vwo or mbo level 4 diploma is mentioned; extra requirements apply for some profiles. Contact the school for a Moroccan diploma.

evidence.quote: Met een havo-, vwo-, of mbo-diploma (niveau 4) word je toegelaten.

notes: Tuition left out: the programme page (https://www.fontys.nl/Opleidingen/Elektrotechniek-bachelor-voltijd.htm) only links a collegegeldmeter and gives no amount. The institution-wide pages (Collegegeld, Kosten en betaling) say instellingscollegegeld applies to students from outside the EEA but give no amount and no study-year row, so no quotable non-EU fee for 2026-2027 or later could be found. Intakes left out: the page states application deadlines only generally (1 mei 2027, 1 februari) without saying they are for non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants. Documents left out: no document list is given on these pages.
